name: FirstArticleInspection
tagline: AS9102-style first article inspection with ballooned characteristics, tolerances, gauges and sign-off.
description: A Power Platform code component that turns a ballooned drawing into a characteristic accountability sheet: measured values evaluated against nominal ± tolerance, gauge calibration checks, NCR capture, Form 2 materials and processes, a drawing map and an approve/reject sign-off.
features: Form 3 characteristic accountability with automatic pass/fail
Tolerance band with LSL/USL, nominal and samples
Form 2 materials, special processes, functional tests
Form 1 summary, readiness checklist and sign-off
Phone card layout, keyboard operation, read-only mode
